blurb: The Salt Pond Golf Club offers a professionally manicured 18-hole public mid-length golf course nestled within a residential community. The course is challenging for seasoned players yet welcoming for women, juniors, seniors, and beginners. Most foursomes finish the course in less than 3 hours, making it ideal for combining golf with beach activities.
